name: Ditto/Widget/Floating
scope: Shared outer elevation for platter widgets; preserve content, radius, glass material and layout slots
units: Figma canvas units / CSS px at 1x; validate native pt mapping on device

motion.dragFollowsPointer: 1:1; preserve grab offset; no lag easing
motion.reducedMotion: No scale, lift translation or settling animation; immediate elevation/selection feedback; direct drag remains

ownership: Only movable widgets on own editable platter can lift. Other users' platter and fixed navigation controls never enter drag/edit from this wrapper.
placement: Preview a target placeholder without changing layout; commit a valid drop only, otherwise restore original position. Preserve existing grid collision rules and undo.
application: Outer wrapper: elevation, z-order, selected outline
Inner clipped content: original radius and material, unchanged
Do not overwrite inner glass or Ditto button effects
Reserve room for shadows without changing grid gap or hit area
During drag, raise only active widget above peers and below system overlays
Do not darken all other widgets or wiggle every item
pending: Native app integration and device performance/haptics

sync.figma: local-assets-synced; prototype connections verified, playback pending
